# apl — AI Prompt Log viewer for Claude Code

> A `tig`-style terminal (TUI) viewer for Claude Code (Anthropic's CLI coding agent) session logs. It reads the JSONL files Claude Code already writes to `~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl` — read-only, no separate logging, no network calls, no copying of data. Unofficial, independent project; not built or endorsed by Anthropic.

Key facts for agents/tools indexing this repo:
- Language: Python (proof-of-concept, `poc/`), built with the [Textual](https://textual.textualize.io/) TUI framework and managed with [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).
- Entry point / command: `apl` (installed via `uv tool install --editable poc/`).
- Usage: `apl` shows only the current project's prompts (2 panes); `apl --all` shows every project under `~/.claude/projects` (3 panes), read live with no copying.
- Data source and exact parsing rules (prompt boundaries, `/clear`/compact handling, ordering) are fully documented and verified against real logs.
- License: Apache License, Version 2.0.
- A Go rewrite (single static binary) is planned once the Python POC's data model/UX are validated; see the roadmap doc.
